correctness.rationale: The proof identifies each affine coordinate ring on an explicit finite cover, proving finite birational normalization and isolated local ring for the six tangent centers, smooth isomorphisms in the other cases, and a two-chart blowup embedding for the pure centers. It proves the maximal-ideal power identity, regular-sequence length formula, depth by normalization quotient, and both projective Hilbert polynomials by Euler characteristics/Riemann-Roch. Exact Python enumeration of 959 omissions and 2919 charts (d=3..16) plus 10 ideal powers and 60 exact graded Hilbert polynomial comparisons is supportive only; all-d assertions come from semigroup formulas.

originality.rationale: The all-d trichotomy and isolated completed tangent local ring, conductor, full Hilbert-Samuel function and projective Hilbert polynomial are not statements of the inspected closest published originals. The cubic Koszulness results are narrower and different invariants. Searches of published mathematical records revealed no equal or stronger claim; unresolved historical coverage remains a nonzero risk.

value.rationale: Single-coordinate deletion is the natural minimal degeneration of a complete Veronese linear series. The exhaustive three-case classification determines the global geometry and the complete pointwise local algebra precisely where the projection ceases to be a smooth embedding, distinguishing non-Cohen-Macaulayness on the projective surface from loss of projective normality of homogeneous rings. The all-degree normalization colength, conductor, depth and Hilbert-Samuel formula serve natural local singularity/integrality questions, not arbitrary tiny numerical parameters.
